alternate_names: Prachin Shri Sheetla Mata Mandir, Tej Colony

history.period: Not documented (described by devotees as very old)
history.summary: The most likely referent is the Prachin Shri Sheetla Mata Mandir at Tej Colony, Rohtak (124001), about 2.1 km from Rohtak Junction railway station, rated 4.4/5 from 62 reviews on Yappe; reviewers describe it as a very old ('prachin') neighbourhood temple of Goddess Sheetla. No documented history, founder, or construction date was found. Ambiguity: another old Sheetla Mata Mandir is listed on Jind Road (NH-71), Singhpura Khurd, Rohtak, which some reviewers call the 'real and old' Sheetla Mata Mandir of Rohtak — the CSV row could refer to either shrine. Opening hours are undocumented.

name: Prachin Shri Sheetla Mata Mandir
town_description: Rohtak is a city in southeastern Haryana, about 70 km northwest of Delhi on NH-9. It is an educational and commercial hub, known for Tilyar Lake and its rewari and gajak sweets.

travel.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi (approx. 70 km)
